messages.subject: version 0.4.0 of package xlsxjars has been submitted to CRAN
parts:
This contains the version 3.8 (latest) Apache POI jars. 

All the tests I had with package xlsx passed successfully with these jars.  Let me know if you see any problem. 

With this version you can force workbook recalculation on loading with 
wb$setForceFormulaRecalculation(TRUE)

See link below for the list of improvements 
http://www.apache.org/dist/poi/release/RELEASE-NOTES.txt

Adrian
